steps.title: Customer pays & submits new order form
steps.check: Confirm the payment and the order form in the ERP portal.
steps.hint: This is the trigger. Creating an order starts the flow and opens the customer's Telegram group.

steps.title: Sales form shared & signed by customer
steps.check: Confirm the signed sales form is on the order in the ERP portal.
steps.hint: Share the sales form (price, terms etc.). Mark done once the signed copy is back.

steps.title: NLD order raised to telco
steps.check: Look for the telco's acknowledgement on the order email thread.

steps.title: Telco: L1 / L2 confirmation & RA number
steps.check: The telco's L1/L2 request and RA number arrive by email.
steps.hint: Telco asks for L1/L2 confirmation and shares the RA number. Mark done once the RA number is in.

steps.title: Telco shares port details
steps.check: Port details arrive by email from the telco.

steps.title: Telco confirms SFP
steps.check: SFP confirmation arrives by email from the telco.

steps.title: Port details shared with customer; test schedule requested
steps.check: Share the port details in the customer's Telegram group and wait for their test slot.
steps.hint: Send the port details to the customer and ask for a testing schedule. Mark done once the slot is agreed.

steps.title: Customer shares documents for BTYS access
steps.check: The customer posts the BTYS documents in the Telegram group.

steps.title: Access arranged with telco; customer connects device to port
steps.check: Access confirmation from the telco arrives by email.

steps.title: Our team configures (VLAN, IP…) and tests the link
steps.check: Coordinate the link test with the customer in the Telegram group.
steps.hint: Assign VLAN / IP, then test bandwidth and latency before marking done.

steps.title: Customer moved to our RADIUS portal
steps.check: Confirm the move with the customer in the Telegram group.
steps.hint: Runs in parallel with step 9 — unlocks together with it, as soon as the BTYS documents are in.

steps.title: Billing raised; customer confirms; billing starts
steps.check: The customer's billing confirmation arrives by email.
steps.hint: Needs both the link test (10) and the RADIUS move (11) to be complete.

steps.title: Billing confirmed to telco
steps.check: Send the billing confirmation to the telco by email and keep their reply.
